main_text.p: Accusativus contrahitur hic interdum, ut Ποσειδῶν, (Dor. Ποσειδᾶν vel Ποτειδᾶ) accusativo Ποσειδῶ pro Ποσειδῶνα, Απόλλω pro Απόλλωνα.
Gravitona abjiciunt ος vocativo, Τρύφων, Τρύφωνος, ὦ Τρύφων. Απόλλων, Απόλλωνος, ὦ Απολλον retracto (ut prius) accentu.
4. τος: ὁ ἔρως, ἔρωτος vel ἔρω, amor.
main_text.l: ὁ γέλως, γέλωτος vel γέλω, risus.
main_text.p: ὃ φῶς φωτὸς lux: (poetice Φάος Φάεος, & φόως) in duali φωτοῖν. ὁ φὼς, φώτων, vir. Sic

page.notes: Signature "h iiij" at foot. Greek accents and some words in the scan are blurred; readings of Greek forms are doubtful, notably the Greek in the Accusativus and Gravitona paragraphs, and "retracto" is uncertain. A marginal mark "ani" appears at the right edge near line 4 and is not transcribed.
